title: Wood2 Solo #60 (목재 솔로 · rosewood · 체형 BBW bombshell · 인종 ebony · 메이크업 비주얼계 블랙립 5단계 · 극한 · 배경 하얀 안뜰 · 힐 40인치 · 몸 주얼리)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a deep ebony-brown complexion, early 50s goddess, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, shaggy layered auburn hair — full body deep purple-brown rosewood carved directly over her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not a printed pattern, this is solid carved wood curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted carved sections whose grain changes direction from one section to the next, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own soft glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep purple-brown rosewood grain across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID near-black streaks running between the carved sections, with a carved geometric lattice relief across every section, polished to a warm satin sheen, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: strong hip pop left, both hands pressing outer hips outward arching back to extreme — most extreme BBW bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps carved from the same rosewood, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts, while her body keeps its full original proportions — thick heavy thighs, wide full hips and a huge bust exactly as massive as before.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her forearm is wide, carved from the same rosewood with a high polish.
Jewelry: a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, and a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT carved — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: heavily smudged black eyeshadow blazing from the lash line up to the temples, thick smeared black liner all around the eyes, clumped black lashes top and bottom, fully opaque saturated jet-black lips, deeply shadowed black contour under the cheekbones.

Background: a sunlit white-washed courtyard with a pale tiled floor, an arched doorway at normal height, low stone steps and a tall olive tree, bright midday light, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
